short: Constructing Li-Rich Artificial SEI Layer in Alloy-Polymer C
title: Constructing Li-Rich Artificial SEI Layer in Alloy-Polymer Composite Electrolyte to Achieve High Ionic Conductivity for All-Solid-State Lithium Metal Batteries

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: PEO-based solid polymer electrolytes conduct Li+ too poorly near room temperature for all-solid-state Li metal batteries. A Li-rich artificial SEI layer built around Li-alloy fillers inside PEO should give fast Li+ pathways and raise ionic conductivity.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/modification), n4 (DES/route), n6 (PRC/forming)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: The shell formed on Li21Si5 contains Li-rich SEI species RCOO-Li, ROLi and LiF, absent with Si or SiO2 fillers. A distinct amorphous interface layer about 15-25 nm thick separates the imaged Li21Si5 particle from the PEO matrix.
states.detail: Absorbed: n7 (STR/chemistry/composition), n8 (STR/interface), n9 (STR/microstructure/distribution), n10 (STR/phase/fraction). Premises: FTIR 879 cm-1 = ROLi/RCOOLi and 1083 cm-1 = C-O; XPS 55.4/287.8/531.2 eV = RCOO-Li, 56.7/684.9 eV = LiF are DOL-DME SEI components; PEO reflections near 19.2 and 23.5 deg come from crystalline chains; a lower melting endotherm means less stable crystals

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Conductivity of the Li-alloy/PEO interface (~5e-4 S/cm) is about an order higher than Si/PEO or SiO2/PEO interfaces. Higher Li+ concentration in the SEI shell lets ion-ion interactions promote Li+ hopping between chains, a fast interfacial pathway.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (PRP/value), n12 (MEC/pathway), n13 (PRP/value). Premises: Ion-ion interactions at high Li concentration promote Li+ hopping between PEO chains

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Li|PEOm-Li21Si5|Li cell cycles 300 h at 0.2 mA/cm2 and 45 C with ~0.1 V polarization; SiO2 cell ~0.5 V, Si cell fails. LiFePO4 cells with PEOm-Li21Si5 cycle stably for 100 cycles at 30, 45 and 60 C with ~100% Coulombic efficiency

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Li-alloy fillers build a Li-rich artificial SEI inside PEO that raises ionic conductivity and Li+ transference and lets Li metal cells work ~15-20 C cooler than with other fillers

nodes.note: LiF F 1s peak near 685 eV is about as tall as the LiTFSI peak; I-III spectra look alike
